Reason for referral:
Testing for PMP22 duplication.

1. PATIENT has been tested by quantitative fluorescent multiplex PCR assay for a duplication of the peripheral myelin protein 22 gene (PMP-22). This mutation accounts for approximately 70% of all cases of Hereditary Motor and Sensory Neuropathy type 1 (HMSN1).

2. PATIENT DOES NOT have a duplication nor deletion of the PMP-22 gene (test error rate of less than 1%).

3. Therefore a clinical diagnosis of HMSN1 cannot be confirmed. If the diagnosis of HNPP is supported by other clinical tests, the DNA could be forwarded to a specialist laboratory for point mutation screening in the PMP-22 gene.
